item.title: Tupac Shakur murder trial: medical expert gives evidence on rapper’s autopsy – latest updates
item.summary: Dr Lisa Gavin, a forensic pathologist, reviews report and photos of Tupac Shakur’s body from autopsy What we know about Tupac Shakur’s death and what to expect from murder trial District Court Judge Carli Kierney relayed a few questions directly from the jury to medical examiner Dr. Lisa Gavin. “Where there any wounds to the head that you or Dr. Jordan observed or noted?” Continue reading...
